description: This file defines classes, functions, and utilities for capturing, processing, and managing output streams (stdout, stderr, logs) during code execution, including classes for captured data, sinks, controllers, and context managers. It is part of a testing or debugging framework, likely related to the 'behave' BDD testing tool.

classes.name: ICaptured
classes.description: Marker interface for captured output classes.

classes.name: NoCaptured
classes.description: Represents absence of captured output; read-only, default state.

classes.name: Captured
classes.description: Immutable class storing a snapshot of captured stdout, stderr, and logs, with methods for report generation and merging.

classes.name: ManyCaptured
classes.description: Composite class aggregating multiple Captured instances, with methods for managing collections of captured outputs.

classes.name: CaptureSink2Null
classes.description: Null sink implementation that discards captured data.

classes.name: CaptureSinkAsCollector
classes.description: Sink that collects and stores captured outputs.

classes.name: CaptureSink2Print
classes.description: Sink that prints captured output to stdout.

classes.name: CaptureBookmark
classes.description: Reference point in time for captured output, used to get data since this point.

classes.name: CaptureController
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of output capturing, including setup, start, stop, and teardown.

classes.name: CaptureControllerWithResult
classes.description: Extension of CaptureController with result tracking.

classes.name: AnyHook
classes.description: Utility class with flags for hook behavior.

methods.name: add_text_to
methods.description: Utility to concatenate text with separator.

methods.name: require_type
methods.description: Ensures a variable is of a specified type.

methods.name: capture_output_with_controller
methods.description: Context manager to capture output using a specified controller.

methods.name: capture_output_to_sink
methods.description: Context manager that captures output and delegates to a sink.

methods.name: capture_output
methods.description: Decorator to wrap functions for capturing logs and output.
